nodes.name: HTTP - Instagram Create Container
nodes.notes: Step 1 of the Instagram Content Publishing flow: create a media container.

nodes.name: WAIT - Container Processing
nodes.notes: Meta processes the container asynchronously. A short wait avoids publishing an unfinished container.

parameters.url: =https://graph.facebook.com/{{ $('CODE - Instagram Media Preparation').first().json.api_version }}/{{ $('CODE - Instagram Media Preparation').first().json.ig_user_id }}/media_publish

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { ...p, status: 'blocked', platform_post_id: null, published_at: null, raw_response: null, error_detail: { stage: 'publication_preparation', platform: 'instagram', error_code: 'preparation_failed', message: p.prep_errors.join(','), retry_count: 0, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() } } }];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO publications (schedule_id, platform, platform_post_id, published_at, status, error_detail, raw_response) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'instagram', $2, NULLIF($3,'')::timestamptz, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (schedule_id, platform) DO UPDATE SET platform_post_id = EXCLUDED.platform_post_id, published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, status = EXCLUDED.status, error_detail = EXCLUDED.error_detail, raw_response = EXCLUDED.raw_response RETURNING publication_id, schedule_id, platform, platform_post_id, status, published_at;

parameters.jsCode:
const row = $input.first().json || {};
return [{ json: { publication_id: row.publication_id || null, schedule_id: row.schedule_id || null, platform: 'instagram', platform_post_id: row.platform_post_id || null, status: row.status || 'failed', published_at: row.published_at || null, error_detail: row.error_detail || null } }];
